environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). No additional middleware or filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB forwards to port 8080 on instance. Flask app served via gunicorn with 4 workers. SQLite database at /app/data/users.db contains production user records including password hashes and API keys.
